responsibility: This makefile fragment integrates the jit module into GCC’s top-level build and install machinery. It defines how libgccjit is named and linked on ELF, Darwin, and MinGW hosts, which object files make up the shared library, how the jit driver pieces participate in staged builds and tests, and how libgccjit headers and generated documentation are built and installed; in other words, it owns the build-system responsibility for producing libgccjit.so/.dylib/.dll and the associated docs rather than any runtime JIT behavior.
